name: God's Moment of Joy
desc: The Planar Sphere encapsulates the stage in the realm of the Moment of Joy, where every laugh and every tear is etched with a moment Aha holds dear.

effects.2: Increases the wearer's SPD by 6%. When the wearer's Elation stat reaches 40% or higher, advances the wearer's action by 40% immediately upon entering combat.

pieces.name: Moment of Joy's Eternal Stage
pieces.desc: The Planar Sphere encapsulates the stage in the realm of the Moment of Joy, where every laugh and every tear is etched with a moment Aha holds dear.
pieces.backstory:
"What makes joy so precious is that it's always but a fleeting moment~"

THEY will not forget the thrill of the hunt, chasing that vicious beast.
When frail humans huddled in the cracks between leviathans, THEY dared to slip into the beast's maw and steal that precious "Aftertaste."
THEY will not forget the freedom of traversing the cosmos.
Boarding that meteor-like Express, the young god set out on a journey of no return, ultimately parting ways at the end of the world.
THEY will not forget the cry of a newborn child.
Sorrow, much like laughter, can bid farewell to life, yet it may also be a gift from new life to the silent cosmos.
THEY will not forget the Fool's sincere laughter.
In those golden eras, humanity faced terror with courage and dissolved despair with humor.
...

When the mask slipped away from the one beneath it, even THEY had been scarred by that creeping growth of "desire."
And so, THEY transformed the vanishing past into a fleeting eternity, treasuring it within this secret arcadia...
Every moment serves to remind THEM that the curtain has yet to fall on THEIR performance, and that "Elation" was always meant to be a name for humanity.
THEY yearn for someone to journey here and share in the spectacle of this never-ending play.

pieces.name: Moment of Joy's Magic Prop
pieces.desc: A magic prop preserved in the realm of the Moment of Joy. Ribbons entwine THEIR fingertips as the stars spin and sing for THEM.
pieces.backstory:
"Can you even remember how many ribbons you've tossed? With magic, it's not about proving anything, it's about believing."

Sometimes, THEY look down from the high heavens as Wishpower flows and gathers.
Sometimes, THEY sit in the audience, waving glow sticks for a breathtaking performance.
Sometimes, THEY appear at a street corner, tucking the hint of a riddle into the bottom of a surprise box.
Sometimes, THEY don a mask to play the part of an omnipotent god.
For guests hungry for a little fun, THEY serve up a mixed drink.
For travelers chasing the stars, THEY lay out an astral chart.
...
THEY wander through the vast sea of humanity, scattering seeds of wishes among the crowd.
A miracle is like a spark of hope. When people gaze up at the moon, they can harvest the fuel to change reality.

"If the Trailblaze is a gentle push when people are confounded, then the Elation is that little pull when they fall!"
For a thousand Amber Eras, "the Elation" has never been the grand protagonist, but rather a divine spark clinging to all things.
People cannot put its true essence into words. They can only hold onto blurry memories of those instants that could be called "the Elation": love arriving in the hazy twilight, stars surging up in the dark, a cool breeze on a summer evening, and the moment of recovering something lost...
Those truly are magical moments, dyeing all the pale fragments of life with a color worth cherishing.
Do you remember those moments? Are you smiling too?
"Aha... the magic has already done its work."
